snippet.title: Whirlight - No Time To Trip | Steam Next Fest Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into a different moment in time.

This new trailer introduces Margaret, one of the two protagonists of Whirlight – No Time To Trip, in a special demo available during Steam Next Fest (February).

Try the demo now on Steam and don’t forget to add us to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2706980/Whirlight__No_Time_To_Trip/
